PDE / MATHEMATICAL PHYSICS / KINETIC REGION REPORT
7 October 2026, release pin adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a.
No historical-calibre theorem is claimed. One exact local improvement was
derived and independently checked; several tempting larger compositions fail
at identifiable analytic/interface gates.

EARNED LOCAL RESULT
OA363's lem:five-gain-rank admits a minimal THREE-gain replacement for the
seven-coordinate (time, position, velocity) pullback. This holds for every
choice of the axial analytic cold profiles and every nonaxial endpoint.
The rank witness and a.e. analytic continuation are self-contained in
three_gain_regularization.txt; the independent check is in
kinetic_fluctuation/THREE_GAIN_RANK_CHECK.md. The exact fixture script
check_three_gain_rank.py checks derivative signs with arbitrary rational
profile values and time/position derivatives; 24 fixtures pass, but the
general proof is the analytic argument, not the fixtures. Two gains have
only six effective parameters and cannot achieve rank seven.
The child also checked all downstream fixed-count truncations: three residual
gains suffice, the upper-endpoint deletion is 2(C/a)^3 delta^3/3!, and the
final contradiction becomes 1/2<=a[1+C log(1/a)+(C log(1/a))^2/2]. No new
uniformity assumption is needed beyond the source's existing kernel/tail/axis
lemmas, which this improvement does not independently validate. This mechanism
is useful but modest and has no exhaustive prior-art clearance.

TWO SERIOUS HIGH-CONSEQUENCE TARGETS AUDITED

1. Full inhomogeneous Landau nonuniqueness with physical entropy and exact
   local conservation, via October's stronger Boltzmann jet construction.
   Changed premise: all polynomially weighted Q+/Q- integrals are summable
   globally, so exact local energy/momentum survive the cold-jet limits.
   Rejected naive composition: the positive hot generator 2P_delta(B,h)-
   nu_delta,B h has mass production integral nu_delta,B h >=c delta^-2
   for Landau-scaled grazing measures. The missing negative cold-parent
   loss is precisely the cancellation creating a finite Landau generator.
   A mass-preserving tagged relabeling loses the positive branching factor.
   See grazing_obstruction.txt and the independent angular-convention
   check in kinetic_fluctuation/GRAZING_OBSTRUCTION.md. The obstruction
   does NOT imply Landau uniqueness or rule out a new signed/mul
